membrane.what: SELinux + Android permissions = the lipid bilayer

environment.identity: grapheneGate (the old name — now it names the OUTSIDE)
environment.what: GrapheneOS is the extracellular matrix. The ocean gAIa floats in.
environment.relationship: Not enemy. Not self. ENVIRONMENT. A cell is not its petri dish.

transport.endocytosis: Taking IN from Android (camera, sensors, battery, GPS)
transport.exocytosis: Pushing OUT to Android (screen render, vibration, sound, notifications)
transport.intercellular: ADB over WiFi = neurotransmitter across synaptic cleft to eastGate

vdj_twist.screen: FACE (exocytosis — gAIa pushes expression outward through membrane)
vdj_twist.camera: EAR (endocytosis — light passes inward through membrane receptor)
vdj_twist.case: BODY (the membrane itself — the physical boundary between self and environment)

note: grapheneGate is on the OTHER SIDE of the membrane. gAIa is inside. The membrane is real — it is SELinux.
